name: Asa
summary: A king of Judah, son of Abijah, who did what was right in the eyes of the LORD and put away the idols in the land. Later he relied on the king of Syria instead of the LORD, and in his disease he sought the physicians.

key_moments.title: Cleansing the Land
key_moments.description: Asa removed the idols his fathers had made. He even removed his mother Maachah from being queen because of her idol, and burned it by the brook Kidron.

key_moments.title: A Prayer Before Battle
key_moments.description: Zerah the Ethiopian came against Judah with a huge army near Mareshah. Asa cried to the LORD for help, and the LORD struck the Ethiopians before Judah.

key_moments.title: A Covenant to Seek the LORD
key_moments.description: After the prophet Azariah urged him on, Asa put away the idols and gathered the people at Jerusalem. They made a covenant to seek the LORD with all their heart.

key_moments.title: Paying Syria for Help
key_moments.description: When Baasha king of Israel built Ramah against Judah, Asa sent silver and gold to Ben-hadad of Syria for help. The seer Hanani rebuked him for relying on Syria and not the LORD, and Asa put him in prison.

key_moments.title: Diseased in His Feet
key_moments.description: In his last years Asa was diseased in his feet, yet he did not seek the LORD, only the physicians. He died and was buried in the tomb he had made in the city of David.
